context: Monday morning at the office coffee machine. Yuki and Kenji catch up briefly about their weekends before the first meeting starts.
purpose: small monday catch-up — gentle re-acclimation to the workweek through ordinary talk

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おはよう。週末はどうだった？
lines.style: Earnest salaryman warmth, mild morning fatigue threaded through, polite curiosity in steady measured cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: おはよう。映画見に行ってきた、土曜日。
lines.en: Morning. I went to see a movie on Saturday.
lines.style: Bright office warmth, conversational lift on 「映画」, easygoing energy with a small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Genuine interest cut into the salaryman politeness, slight lift on 「何」 inviting more.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: あの新しいやつ。すごく良かったよ。
lines.en: That new one. It was really good.
lines.style: Quick recommend energy, voice warming on 「すごく良かった」 with sincere enthusiasm pulling the words forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Practical salaryman concern surfacing, steady measured cadence checking before he considers going himself.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、結構ね。でも見る価値あった。
lines.en: Yeah, pretty much. But it was worth seeing.
lines.style: Honest acknowledging tone, then a recommend-it lift on the second clause, warm and credible throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: じゃあ次の週末行ってみようかな。
lines.en: Then I might go this coming weekend.
lines.style: Thoughtful salaryman planning voice, gentle 「かな」 trailing off as he considers it seriously.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: おすすめ。早めに予約したほうがいいよ。
lines.en: I recommend it. Better to book early.
lines.style: Helpful office friend cadence, slight forward lean in the voice giving practical advice with warmth.
